description: Finds press releases already published by the network for a company or website domain (title, publication, date, URL, how it is labelled), for example to document where a client appeared. Public information only, at most 20 results, newest first. Read only.

desde.description: Only releases published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (optional).

dominio.description: Website domain of the company, e.g. example.com (optional if empresa is given).

empresa.description: Company name or part of it (at least 3 characters).

name: buscar_notas
title: Find published press releases
